We're NODI, a Berlin-based consumer electronics startup. We build the NODI Flip, a screen-free audio device for kids, with Spotify integration, voice messaging, offline content, and optional LTE. Our mission: give children music, audiobooks, and a connection to their family without putting them in front of a screen.
As our Technical Customer Support Specialist (Level 2), you're the technical backbone of our support team, the person who takes over when things get tricky.
http://www.nodi.kids
Tasks
Diagnosing and resolving technical cases: failed firmware (OTA) updates, WiFi and LTE connectivity issues, app pairing, Spotify integration
Deciding whether a device can be fixed remotely or needs replacement, and owning the replacement process
Escalating reproducible bugs to our engineering team with clean, structured documentation they can act on directly
Answering tickets in our helpdesk in German and English, friendly, clear, and in the informal tone parents know us for
Maintaining and expanding our Help Center and reply templates so Level 1 and our AI-assisted drafts keep getting better
Working with AI tools that pre-draft replies, your job is increasingly to review, improve, and solve the hard cases, not type on an assembly line.

Experience in technical customer support (Level 2 or comparable), ideally with hardware or IoT products
Genuine technical depth: you troubleshoot systematically and can explain technology in a way stressed parents understand
Very good written and spoken-level German and English
Experience with a helpdesk system (Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar)
A self-directed, structured way of working. We have short paths and lots of ownership
Bonus: experience with firmware/OTA topics, Bluetooth/WiFi diagnostics, or products for kids and families

A product you can stand behind. Parents love it, and so do kids
Direct impact: your support insights feed straight into product and engineering decisions
Modern tooling and AI-assisted workflows
Hybrid work: a mix of home office and our Berlin or Düsseldorf office

Further benefits: lunch allowance, and of course, your own NODI Flip.
Sounds like you? Send us your CV and a few sentences on why technical support is your thing, no formal cover letter needed. The process includes a short practical exercise with real (anonymized) tickets, so you see what the work actually looks like and we see how you think.

As the Manager, Quality Assurance within Customer Support, you will play a key role in shaping how we measure, maintain, and improve the quality of our customer experience across every support interaction.

You’ll lead the evolution of our QA program, helping define the frameworks, processes, and operational strategies that enable our teams to deliver consistent, high-quality support at scale.

By leveraging AI-powered QA tooling, you’ll surface actionable insights, identify emerging themes, and help drive continuous improvements in support quality and team performance.
Our QA program is still in its early stages, with foundational processes already in place but significant opportunity to iterate, expand, and mature the function over time. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in evolving environments and is excited by the opportunity to help shape a modern QA program while balancing strategic ownership with hands-on execution.
Reporting into Customer Support leadership, you will partner closely with Support Operations, frontline leaders, Enablement, Product, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for operational improvement, coaching, and quality enhancements across the customer journey. You’ll help establish scalable QA methodologies, calibration practices, reporting structures, and feedback loops that drive accountability and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
In this role, you’ll also help shape how QA supports AI-powered customer experiences. As AI-assisted workflows and responses continue to evolve, you’ll evaluate both human and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the customer experience we aim to deliver. Your ability to identify trends, uncover friction points, and drive targeted quality initiatives will directly influence both team effectiveness and customer experience.
This role has the potential to evolve into direct people leadership of QA specialists or QA team leads as the function grows.

AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

You’ll work in a small, focused team handling the trickier support queries we get from farmers, digging into data, diagnosing issues, and helping deliver world-class support.

In practice, that means solving the issues Tier 2 can't crack themselves, and escalating to Guidance Ops only what genuinely needs their expertise.

Your job is to own the quality of Tier 2's work within virtual fencing, make sure what reaches Guidance Ops is genuinely something only they can solve, well diagnosed and well evidenced, and enable Tier 2 to resolve more virtual fencing issues on their own over time.
Day to day, you'll dig into animal behaviour data to work out exactly what a cow did and why. You'll learn how farm systems actually work, so the advice you're giving farmers and Tier 2 is grounded in how a real farm runs, not just what the data says in isolation. You'll get close enough to the product that you can tell the difference between a training issue, a set up issue, and when something's genuinely wrong, and you'll know which of those is worth Guidance Ops' time and which isn't.
Some of this you'll solve from your desk, and some of it you'll solve standing in a paddock. When an issue needs eyes on the ground, you'll get out on farm to see it firsthand rather than relying on secondhand descriptions. You'll own working across our Customer Experience and Customer teams as the expert in this space.
You're not just a pass-through. You pick up and solve the most complex virtual fencing issues yourself, working directly alongside Guidance Ops, so the two of you are jointly closing out the hardest cases rather than you simply routing them on.
You’ll spend most of your days on the R&D farm near Morrinsville . We turned the old calf barn into an office with prime views of our farm. Once or twice a fortnight, you’ll head up to our HQ in Auckland to work closely with our support and onboarding teams, making sure our farmers get the best support possible. While we aim to solve most issues remotely, sometimes you’ll be out on customers’ farms, hands-on, helping them directly.

Own Tier 2 quality in your domain: be accountable for how well Tier 2 handles virtual fencing issues, stepping in on quality gaps and raising the bar on diagnosis before things reach you.
Own the escalation layer: be the checkpoint between Tier 2 and Guidance Ops, making sure only genuinely complex virtual fencing issues get through, and that they arrive well diagnosed.
Solve the hardest cases: work directly with Guidance Ops on the most complex virtual fencing problems, picking up real ownership of the fix, not just the handover.
Get out on farm: head out when an issue needs eyes on the ground, seeing firsthand how the collar and fencing behave rather than relying on secondhand descriptions.
Work with the escalations team: partner with our escalations specialists when a virtual fencing issue is tangled up with a broader account or customer health.
Build Tier 2's capability: turn what you learn into knowledge, playbooks, and training that let Tier 2 resolve more virtual fencing issues without needing to escalate at all.
Go deep on the product: develop and hold expert-level understanding of how the collar and virtual fencing system actually works, how cattle interact with it, and why things go wrong.
Close the loop with Guidance Ops: feed back patterns and root causes from what's reaching Tier 3, so Guidance Ops has a clear signal on what's actually happening in the field.
